seo_title: ElectraSim — Free Online Electrical Wiring Simulator & Circuit Trainer
seo_description: Build, energise and fault-find real domestic wiring in your browser. 115 components, live simulation, Guided Circuits, Challenge and Diagnosis modes, fault simulation and an electrical toolbox. Free, offline-capable, no sign-up.
hero_description: An interactive wiring lab that behaves like the real thing. Place a breaker, run the cable, close the switch — and watch current actually flow, trip and fault.
release_heading: Everything that has landed since the last big update
release_description: The simulator, the learning tools and the website have moved quickly. Here is the working feature set that is live today.

release_highlights.title: Dark mode across app & site
release_highlights.body: Light, Dark or System in the simulator; a persistent theme toggle in the website navigation. Every panel, documentation screen and phone control follows your choice.

release_highlights.title: RCBO + a push button that holds
release_highlights.body: Add a two-pole RCBO and a momentary Push Button for doorbells and control circuits. Newly placed protection devices start in their intended ready position.

release_highlights.title: Guided Circuits with checklists
release_highlights.body: Eight pre-built circuit templates land on the canvas — protected lamp, two-way staircase, RCD earth-fault demo, Pro SPD consumer unit and more — each with an in-app checklist.

release_highlights.title: Fault Simulation Mode
release_highlights.body: Inject wire breaks, reverse polarity and missing earths, then watch the protective device respond. Reuse a seed to reproduce an identical diagnosis exercise.

release_highlights.title: Smart + custom wiring
release_highlights.body: Two clicks gives a tidy right-angle run that avoids components, or switch to custom wiring to place every corner yourself. Existing wires keep their paths.

release_highlights.title: Offline, exportable, shareable
release_highlights.body: Install it as a PWA. Save locally, import/export schema-versioned JSON, SVG or 2× PNG, and share the whole circuit in one URL with no backend.

release_highlights.title: Keyboard & accessibility pass
release_highlights.body: Full keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support, focus states and a colour-blind canvas preset. Larger circuits stay smooth with an off-thread solver.

release_highlights.title: Electrical Toolbox
release_highlights.body: BS 7671 voltage drop, cable sizing and Max Zs calculators sit next to the wiring guide, the comparison page and the release notes — free, no sign-up, no tracking.

features_heading: A wiring bench that answers back
features_description: Every component is modelled — ports, poles, ratings and behaviour. Close a switch and the engine re-solves the Live, Neutral and Earth paths, then shows you what that means.

features.title: 115-component palette
features.body: MCBs, RCDs, RCBOs, AFDDs, SPDs and MCCBs. Sockets for BS 1363, Schuko, US, AS/NZS and BS 546. Contactors, relays, timers, thermostats, transformers, 3-phase boards and motors.

features.title: Live path tracing
features.body: The engine walks the real Live / Neutral / Earth topology. Energised wires animate current direction, bulbs glow to their wattage, fans spin and motors pulse.

features.title: Honest fault behaviour
features.body: Open neutral, missing earth, short to live, reverse polarity, overload. Protective devices trip because the circuit says they should — not because a script fired.

features.title: Smart + custom routing
features.body: Two clicks and the router lays a tidy orthogonal path around obstacles — L-route in under a millisecond, A* for dense boards. Or draw the run yourself, checkpoint by checkpoint.

features.title: Pro standards mode
features.body: Regulatory gating before the simulation starts, Zs checks, and heat / voltage-drop diagnostics banded along the cable route. Teacher override is recorded as an audit event.

features.title: Export and hand over
features.body: Schema-versioned JSON, animated SVG, 2× PNG, a printable title block, or a share URL that carries the whole circuit in the fragment. No backend, ever.

modes_description: Free-build is where most simulators stop. These are the modes that tell you whether you got it right.

modes.title: Challenge Mode
modes.body: Hand-authored builds judged by an ordered rule checklist — protected lamp, momentary doorbell, RCBO-fed socket. Rules are checked on topology, not coordinates, so any electrically equivalent wiring passes.
points: Safe workspace — your circuit is snapshotted and restored
Functional rules proven against the real simulator

modes.title: Diagnosis Lab
modes.body: The generator breaks a working circuit on purpose and hands it to you. Find the fault, prove it, repair it. Trip messages that would name the fault are withheld so the answer stays hidden.
points: Deterministic from a seed — copy it, paste it, same circuit

modes.title: Ohmageddon
modes.body: Opt-in punishment. Compound faults, misleading symptoms and a timer. Electrically honest — never unfair — but it will not hold your hand.
points: Same seed system, so a brutal run is shareable

how_description: No account, no download, no setup. Open it and start wiring.

steps.title: Open the bench
steps.body: Loads straight into the browser and keeps working offline after the first visit. Install it as an app if you want it on the home screen.

steps.title: Place the gear
steps.body: Pick supply, protection, switching and loads from the palette. Everything snaps to the grid, and Pro mode recommends parts that match your standard and plug system.

steps.title: Run the cable
steps.body: Click a port, click the destination, and the router finds a tidy path around whatever is in the way. Port types are validated as you go.

steps.title: Energise and break it
steps.body: Run the simulation, flip switches, then inject a fault and watch the protective device do its job. Undo is bounded to the last 100 states.

usecases_description: Anyone who needs to understand a circuit before touching one.

use_cases.title: Apprentices & students
use_cases.body: Practise domestic wiring with no shock risk and no consumables. Run the same exercise until the sequence is muscle memory.

use_cases.title: Lecturers & trainers
use_cases.body: Demonstrate live on a projector, then hand out one seed so every learner gets the identical fault to diagnose.

use_cases.title: Working electricians
use_cases.body: Sketch a board before you cut anything, prove a switching arrangement, or show a customer why the RCD keeps tripping.

use_cases.title: Hobbyists & makers
use_cases.body: Understand what is behind the faceplate. Relays, contactors, timers and PIR sensors, all safe to get wrong.

blog_description: Regulations, circuit theory and step-by-step installs — the same material the simulator is built on.
cta_description: Free, instant, and everything stays on your device. No account, no download, no risk.
